item.title: Coffee Around the World: 12 Regional Brewing Traditions Every Home Barista Should Know
item.description: From Vietnamese phin to Turkish cezve, kopi tubruk to dalgona — a guided tour of 12 regional coffee brewing traditions, what makes each distinct, and how to make them at home.
